reviewer: Codex / approved WP92 dependency and WP82 release review
findings: Membership inserts explicitly supply gen_random_uuid(); conflict updates preserve the existing membership_id. Native organization membership is inserted before department relationships to satisfy the production composite FK.

Both repaired department triggers are now captured from Production, use public.departments, and fix search_path to empty. The original captured definitions remain in pre-cutover-20261105.json for upgrade and rollback rehearsal.

The two migrations are transactional. Contradictory legacy tenant and duplicate department keys fail with no partial DDL or native data loss; failed migration rollback is tested separately for each migration.

Legacy import preserves organization/source IDs and disabled status. EA versus corpId imports encrypted credentials only as an unverified draft; it does not activate the source, apply the directory, rename the enterprise or grant login.

Store/apply/rollback RPCs remain service-role-only and validate tenant, immutable plan, source/config revisions and current directory state. Native service-role tests exercise the full transaction under empty search_path. Browser roles are denied.

Directory apply creates inactive people with login_enabled=false and invited organization membership, without passwords or roles. Full native organization readback uses the captured production RPC rather than a stub.

Rollback updates original memberships in place, preserves membership IDs, removes only data created by this plan and rejects later state changes or business references. Application rollback is tested under production foreign keys. Successful additive DDL is retained for website rollback; destructive down-migration is not authorized.
Real unique identity mapping is enforced, and duplicate inserts are expected to fail. No production constraint, RLS policy or table grant is weakened to make tests pass.
Current Production PostgreSQL 17.6 metadata includes the already-deployed directory wrappers, role ownership, permission registry and trigger dependencies. Snapshot contains schema metadata only.
Capture adds seven tables and seventeen functions compared to the prior narrow scope. It retains foreign-key closure and enumerates textual function calls explicitly.

The role/department authorization-subject check is restored with its original IN expression to preserve PostgreSQL 17.6 catalog equality. The renderer uses that syntax only for the exact known constraint definition and does not weaken the comparison.

The current expanded snapshot was restored on PostgreSQL 17.6 and its catalog matched a new read-only capture. A populated service-role fixture exercised the actual directory v1 and v2, role insertion and department-lead cleanup. Browser role access stayed denied. The November 5 historical snapshots and both original migration files retain their exact bytes.

Production now blocks direct department reparenting by browser and service database roles through the controlled parent-change trigger. The membership-end trigger clears pending Fxiaoke role assignments and revokes pending personnel invitations. The nullable pending_target_revision column scopes pending personal permission differences.

The Production Fxiaoke prelogin helper separates stopped login from eligibility for pending-role revocation. The directory RPC runs as SECURITY DEFINER with existing execute grants and publishes the distinct preassignment and revocation capability flags.

Refreshed from the authenticated read-only Supabase Production catalog captured at 2026-11-27T11:35:48.937Z on PostgreSQL 17.6. It contains 20 tables and 30 functions and only schema metadata. The historic pre-cutover baseline and original migration hashes are preserved.

The role usage check now references private.department_automatic_role_rules. Capture explicitly selects that table and follows its foreign keys; the existing pending Fxiaoke roles and invitations already cover departure-trigger targets. The verifier still requires exact catalog equality.

A disposable native PostgreSQL 17.6 instance exactly reproduced the refreshed catalog. Service-role fixtures verified stopped-login revoke-only visibility, departure cleanup, blocked direct parent edits, and a retired role visible through a real automatic department role reference.
